description_en: Queries the endpoint groups that are associated with a custom routing listener
description_zh: 调用ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroups接口查询自定义路由类型监听关联的终端节点组
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-custom-routing-endpoint-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --endpoint-group-id epg-bp14sz7ftcwwjgrdm0000 --access-log-switch on --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：**50**。默认值：**10**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom routing listener
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the access log feature is enabled.

You can set the parameter to **on**.

If you leave the parameter empty, all endpoint groups are returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启了访问日志。取值：

  **on**：已开启访问日志。

该参数为空时，不进行筛选，返回所有终端节点组
parameters.name: access_log_switch
